nativeCorpus.method: Canonical run_isolated_corpora; fixed public self-source and private application Git snapshots, bounded fresh subprocesses, pre/post content verification and a 200-file batch cap.
nativeCorpus.diagnosticComparison: Every diagnostic, message and location is unchanged after removing severity and severity-derived fingerprints; zero execution issues in all retained trials.
nativeCorpus.limitations: Historical finite source snapshots are not fleet-wide precision/recall estimates. The 92 SARJ541/542 review matches include legitimate independent fields and genuine exception protocols; they are not labeled runtime defects. Whole-project self-lint additionally reviews imports that cross the corpus batch boundaries. TypeScript corpus trials without a provisioned dependency/type graph were discarded; TypeScript qualification uses the native rule suite, managed-config integration, prior catalog evidence and self-lint.

performance.method: Three fresh-process trials per variant over the same immutable inputs; later trials alternate baseline/candidate, with a warm filesystem. The baseline uses an isolated install of the original public source and identical locked dependencies.
performance.limitations: Shared-machine timings include process startup and index preparation. No persistent-engine warm timing, aggregate peak-memory or universal performance claim is made. The timed trials preceded the upstream module-output consumer expansion; final-base correctness is qualified separately.

verification.requiredBeforeMerge: Complete make verify and exact-head hosted checks; native CLI exit/baseline/suppression and CSS severity paths are exercised.
